title: Terminal unit augmentation in the active-source cylinder comma category
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functor categories, full subcategories, mapping spaces and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and symmetric monoidal infinity categories of [lem-coef-symmetric-monoidal-segal-classification]. Let $p:C^\otimes\to N(\mathsf{Fin}_*)$ be a symmetric monoidal infinity category whose tensor unit $\mathbf1\in C=p^{-1}(\langle1\rangle)$ is terminal: $\operatorname{Map}_C(c,\mathbf1)$ is contractible for every $c$. No product hypothesis on the tensor is imposed. Here $\langle n\rangle=\{*,1,\ldots,n\}$ and an active pointed map $a$ satisfies $a^{-1}(*)=\{*\}$.

Let $I$ be the ordinary subcategory of $\mathsf{Fin}_*\times[1]$ containing all objects and exactly those arrows $(\langle m\rangle,\epsilon)\to(\langle n\rangle,\epsilon')$ for which $\epsilon'=1$ or the underlying pointed map is active. Projection to $\mathsf{Fin}_*$ defines $X=C^\otimes\times_{N(\mathsf{Fin}_*)}N(I)$. Write $A=X|_{\{0\}}$ and $B=X|_{\{1\}}$; thus $A$ retains only arrows over active maps, and $B=C^\otimes$. For $x\in B$ over $\langle n\rangle$, choose $x^+\in A$ corresponding to the tuple $(x_1,\ldots,x_n,\mathbf1)$ under the Segal equivalence. Let $\alpha_x:(x^+,0)\to(x,1)$ be a cocartesian edge for $X\to N(I)$ over the pointed map $\pi_n:\langle n+1\rangle\to\langle n\rangle$ fixing $1,\ldots,n$ and sending $n+1$ to $*$, together with $0\to1$.

Then $\alpha_x$ is terminal in $K_x=A\times_X X_{/(x,1)}$, the coherent comma category of arrows $(a,0)\to(x,1)$, with source-change arrows in $A$, fixed target $(x,1)$, and commuting triangles retaining all their higher homotopies. For every object $\theta:(a,0)\to(x,1)$, the full mapping space $\operatorname{Map}_{K_x}(\theta,\alpha_x)$ is contractible. The assertion includes $n=0$, when $x$ is the empty tuple and $x^+=(\mathbf1)$.
